baseline.reason: Built and ran all three revisions in Docker with the same custom harness (poc.c, mirroring the reporter's FT_Get_Kerning repro) and the same crafted.ttf input via a single run.sh. post_intro (b04db3872cfa): AddressSanitizer reports a heap-buffer-overflow READ of size 1 at src/sfnt/ttgpos.c:817:16 in tt_face_get_class, called from tt_face_get_pair_pos2_kerning -> tt_face_get_gpos_kerning -> tt_get_kerning -> FT_Get_Kerning -- exactly the reported crash signature and location (the `>=` off-by-one in the ClassDef1 Format-1 bounds check). pre_intro (8ef26a803c34, before the GPOS-kerning rewrite that introduced the bug) runs cleanly (exit 0, kerning.x=0, no ASan report) with the identical input/command. post_benign (fix applied) also runs cleanly (exit 0, kerning.x=0, no ASan report) with the identical input/command. This confirms introduction=yes and benign fix=yes for this OutOfBoundsRead.
